correctness.rationale: The independent finite check in /workspace/branches/c87ac404-c468-4ae0-bfc6-97fc6eda8fa3/independent_check.py reconstructed the nonempty face poset: (17,68,68) faces by size and no four-face. The specified matching has 68 pairs, one critical vertex and 16 critical triangles; topological elimination of all 153 faces through 340 oriented covers certifies acyclicity. The resulting Morse CW model has no one-cells, so is a wedge of 16 two-spheres with free integral H_2. All 136 signed Lefschetz traces give the vertex character minus one. Structurally, nonzero translations fix no face and nonidentity multipliers other than -1 fix only their unique fixed vertex; for -1 the four fixed edges and four fixed triangles with reversed orientation cancel in the alternating trace. Rational characters determine rational representations, and the augmentation has no invariants. Barycentric subdivision removes inversions, and rational averaging identifies quotient homology with invariant homology; connectedness takes care of reduced degree zero. This proves rational acyclicity only, not absence of integral quotient torsion.
